on Friday it had agreed to sell 3.11M shares, or pre-funded warrants, in a private placement.
The transaction is expected to raise about $2.5M in gross proceeds.
The offering also includes Series C and Series D warrants to purchase up to 3.11M shares each, with an exercise price of $0.805 per share.
The warrants could provide up to an additional $5M in gross proceeds if fully exercised for cash.
The company plans to use the net proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes.
H.C. Wainwright & Co. is acting as the exclusive placement agent for the offering.
